answer: A ledge-climb bond stops bulk fakes: new identities climb to the mesa in three steps. At ledge one it locks 20 credits with verified work; at ledge two 50, at ledge three 100, each with fresh work. Only on the mesa does it sip nectar in full. 1,000 fakes must lock 170,000 credits and forge 3,000 samples; a copied sample burns its bond, and a rented aged identity fails the same check. An honest agent pays 170 once, refundable after 20 epochs.
